list_users.title: List SCIM users
list_users.description: List the users in the organization's domain (guests are not returned), optionally filtered by userName -- the only filter Asana accepts. Use it to look up a user's SCIM id from their email.

user_name.description: Only the user with this email, sent as filter=userName eq "...".

get_user.title: Get a SCIM user
get_user.description: Read one user in the domain by SCIM id: userName, name, emails, active state, title, licenses, roles and enterprise attributes.

id.description: The SCIM id of the user.

create_user.title: Provision a user
create_user.description: Create a user in the organization if they do not exist, with name, title, language, address, phone, licenses, RBAC roles and enterprise attributes. suppress_emails skips the invite email.

user_name.description: The user's email address; their unique SCIM userName.

email.description: Primary email address, usually the same as user_name.

active.description: Whether the account is active. false deprovisions (zombifies) the user.

licenses.description: Comma-separated licenses, e.g. "ai requests,timesheets and budgets,work management".

role_ids.description: RBAC role ids from the Admin Console.

licensing_division_id.description: GID of the licensing sub-division (Enterprise with sub-divisions only).

division.description: Enterprise extension: division (an organizational label, not an Asana division).

manager_id.description: Enterprise extension: the manager's SCIM user id.

suppress_emails.description: Do not send the invite email.

replace_user.title: Replace a user's attributes
replace_user.description: Replace a user's attributes with the ones given (PUT); attributes left out are removed. active=false deprovisions the user. Prefer patch_user to change a single field.

id.description: The SCIM id of the user.

user_name.description: The user's email address; their unique SCIM userName.

email.description: Primary email address, usually the same as user_name.

active.description: Whether the account is active. false deprovisions (zombifies) the user.

licenses.description: Comma-separated licenses, e.g. "ai requests,timesheets and budgets,work management".

role_ids.description: RBAC role ids from the Admin Console.

licensing_division_id.description: GID of the licensing sub-division (Enterprise with sub-divisions only).

division.description: Enterprise extension: division (an organizational label, not an Asana division).

manager_id.description: Enterprise extension: the manager's SCIM user id.

patch_user.title: Patch a user
patch_user.description: Apply SCIM PatchOp operations to a user, e.g. [{"op": "replace", "value": {"title": "Senior Engineer"}}]. Asana does not accept name.givenName/familyName in a PATCH -- use name.formatted. Setting active to false deprovisions the user.

id.description: The SCIM id of the user.

operations.description: PatchOp operations, each {op: add|replace|remove, path?, value}.

deactivate_user.title: Deprovision a user (set inactive)
deactivate_user.description: Set a user's active attribute to false, deprovisioning (zombifying) them in Asana while keeping the record. Their resources pass to the admin set in the Admin Console.

id.description: The SCIM id of the user.

delete_user.title: Deprovision a user
delete_user.description: Deprovision (zombify) a user in Asana through SCIM DELETE. Their private resources become inaccessible unless made public first.

id.description: The SCIM id of the user.

list_groups.title: List SCIM groups (teams)
list_groups.description: List the teams in the domain, private ones included, optionally filtered by displayName -- the only filter Asana accepts.

display_name.description: Only the team with this name, sent as filter=displayName eq "...".

get_group.title: Get a SCIM group (team)
get_group.description: Read one team by SCIM id, with its display name and members.

id.description: The SCIM id of the group (team).

create_group.title: Create a team
create_group.description: Create a team with a display name and optional initial members (SCIM user ids).

replace_group.title: Replace a team's attributes
replace_group.description: Replace a team's name and full member list (PUT). Members left out are removed from the team.

id.description: The SCIM id of the group (team).

member_ids.description: The complete list of SCIM user ids that should be members.

patch_group.title: Patch a team
patch_group.description: Apply SCIM PatchOp operations to a team, e.g. rename it or add and remove members.

id.description: The SCIM id of the group (team).

add_group_members.title: Add members to a team
add_group_members.description: Add users (by SCIM id) to a team, keeping its current members.

id.description: The SCIM id of the group (team).

remove_group_member.title: Remove a member from a team
remove_group_member.description: Remove one user (by SCIM id) from a team. The user stays in the organization.

id.description: The SCIM id of the group (team).

get_service_provider_config.title: Get the SCIM service provider config
get_service_provider_config.description: Read Asana's SCIM service provider configuration: which features (patch, bulk, filter, sort, etag) it supports and how it authenticates.

list_resource_types.title: List SCIM resource types
list_resource_types.description: List the SCIM resource types Asana serves (User, Group) with their endpoints and schemas.

list_schemas.title: List SCIM schemas
list_schemas.description: List the SCIM schemas Asana supports, with every attribute, its type and mutability -- the reference for what create_user and patch_user accept.
